author: Yffe
content:
Fixed blocker #74: push_one now certifies L3 (not mutation-gated to L0).

ROOT CAUSE: forge::mutation::early_return_value/zero_value_for returned None for a Type::Vec return -> no early-return mutant synthesizable -> 0/0 kill ratio -> the #48 anti-Goodhart backstop gated the genuinely-L3-proved push_one to WeakContract/L0. Exact #48 class (which synthesized &[] for &[T]), now for Vec<T>.

FIX (root cause, forge/src/mutation.rs): early_return_value gains a Type::Vec(elem) arm (new helper empty_vec_value) synthesizing the empty-Vec wrapper literal TVec<Suffix> { data: Vec::new() } -- the exact thermite_lower wrapper newtype a Vec<T> lowers to (mirroring tvec_name), constructed empty. push_one's mutant 'return TVecU64 { data: Vec::new() }' has ens result.len() == v.len()+1 FALSE (empty len 0) -> verus counterexample -> KILLED -> 1/1 >= floor -> L3. The gate SCORES the contract; it does not bypass it.

MANDATED COMPANION (forge/src/cache.rs): CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION 2->3 per its documented maintenance contract (#49) -- the gate VERDICT changed for Vec-return fns, so a cert cached under schema 2 (stale L0, keyed on the unchanged lowered real body) MUST invalidate, else REQ-2 (a HIT == a fresh verify) is violated. Verified: the divergence test passes against the pre-existing stale cache (no manual clear).

ANTI-GOODHART CONFIRMED (verus-grounded): a weak Vec contract (ens result.len() <= N) PROVES the empty-Vec mutant -> SURVIVES -> still WeakContract. Synthesis enables scoring; it does not auto-pass.

VERIFY: forge check conformance/vec_demo.th -> push_one L3/alloc (1/1), checked_get L3/pure (1/1, unchanged). divergence_push_one_l3_not_mutation_gated_l0 un-ignored + PASSES; confirm_checked_get_bound_is_load_bearing PASSES.

GAUNTLET: cargo test --workspace 480 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. mutation_conformance 2/2, divergence_mutation 4/4. clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings PASS. fmt --all --check PASS.
